title: Octane agent styling failure intake ledger

id.description: Permanent intake ID. Never renamed or reused.

fixture.description: Repo-relative path to the .tsrx repro fixture reduced from the observed failure.

failure.description: The observed agent styling failure: what the agent did and how it broke.

expectedCode.description: The diagnostic code recorded as this repro's expected catch. Until the code is registered the fixture must still compile silently; once registered the fixture must produce it.

disposition.description: Triage target: diagnostic:<code> for a registered diagnostic the fixture produces, eval:<task-id> for a user-apps-v1 eval task, prose:<path> for a documentation file.
